description: Ex-SAAF Harvard displayed at Garrison Support Base Thaba Tshwane, the SA Army garrison south-west of Pretoria. Listed there in both the 2013 forum gate-guard inventory and the current Unofficial SAAF Website list. Not checked on satellite imagery - Thaba Tshwane is a large garrison and no anchor was available to locate the airframe, so coordinates are left blank rather than guessed.
